summary: Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K announcing an interest rate reset on its $2 billion principal amount of 3.375% Limited Recourse Capital Notes Series 1 (subordinated indebtedness), effective June 19, 2026. The new rate of 5.88300% per annum for the five-year period to June 19, 2031, is calculated as the Government of Canada Yield plus 2.839%. Interest is payable semi-annually. The notes mature June 19, 2081, and are secured by 2,000,000 Non-Cumulative Fixed Rate Reset Class 1 Shares Series 27 held in a limited recourse trust. This is a routine debt instrument rate adjustment, not a special situation.
